name: oi-flush-12h
idea: Open interest down 15%+ over 72h while price moved 2.5+ ATR means positions were closed by force (long liquidations into a drop, shorts squeezed into a rally). Forced flow overshoots; once a 12h bar closes back past the previous bar's extreme, trade the reversal. Stop 0.5 ATR beyond the flush extreme, no target, 5-day time stop.
source: Coval & Stafford, Asset fire sales (and purchases) in equity markets (JFE 2007): forced trades push price from value and reverse over weeks; Brunnermeier & Pedersen (RFS 2009) liquidity spirals. Own data: 15-minute long-flush event study 2026-10-20 (+25 bps/60 min, t 1.2, weak).
author: researcher
